description: Change the artist's Promo settings, as Settings › Connected and a campaign's menu in Promo do. Send only what changes. audora_approves_features: "Post these without waiting for your approval" on or off. keep_going: "Keep it going each month" on or off for one campaign between releases (get_promo_settings lists them, with what it costs). On, its next month is planned on its last day and charged its plan price then, each month; turning it on needs the artist's spend permission, turning it off never does. week: "Your week" for one campaign between releases (not 2 a day): weekday_shape names each weekday that posts (mon to sun) with one { kind, lanes }: kind "song" (A song of yours, still on repeat or out now.), "meet" (Who you are and how you make your music.), "with_audora" (Your own post with Audora invited on Instagram.); lanes are accounts the campaign posts to (get_promo_settings lists them), and with_audora keeps Instagram. At least as many days as its posts a week. Saving moves the posts not approved yet onto the new days; approved ones stay. null clears it. Confirm with the artist before you change any of these.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

audora_approves_features.description: "Post these without waiting for your approval": true or false.

keep_going.description: "Keep it going each month" for one campaign between releases.

campaign_id.description: A campaign between releases (get_promo_settings or list_campaigns).

on.description: True to plan its next month on its last day, each month; false to end it on its last day.

week.description: "Your week" for one campaign between releases.

campaign_id.description: A campaign between releases (get_promo_settings or list_campaigns).

weekday_shape.description: The week day by day, e.g. { "tue": [{ "kind": "song", "lanes": ["instagram", "facebook"] }], "fri": [{ "kind": "with_audora", "lanes": ["instagram"] }] }; a weekday left out posts nothing. null clears it.

name: set_promo_settings
title: Change Promo settings
